<p align="center"><strong>Ending 02 of 06 - The Empty Costume</strong></p>


<p align="center">You set the key beside your cup. Elias mouths a warning, but a different voice comes out: &quot;Drink.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">The tea tastes of burnt sugar. You try to say your name and find an empty space where the word should be.</p>

<p align="center">On the chair lies your Halloween coat, still shaped around someone who is no longer there. A new pumpkin lights up in the garden.</p>

<p align="center">THE EMPTY COSTUME - When the next visitor arrives, your voice will join the others asking to be taken home.</p>
